baseline_control.subject: Welcome to the Trading App 👋
baseline_control.structure: Generic welcome greeting followed by descriptive paragraphs about exchange reliability and a static verify button.
baseline_control.dropoff_point: Users hesitate due to perceived paperwork and video-call friction.

baseline_control.subject: Confirm your email address now!
baseline_control.preheader: Please verify your email address to continue
baseline_control.structure: Minimal transactional text with a single confirmation button and legal footer.

baseline_control.subject: Your Market News for August 📰
